text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Today's the day we execute the plan—
I'm counting on both of you!

text_block_list.name: Bono & Mirako
text_block_list.text:
Ooh!
Oooh~.
choice_data_list: You're really fired up, what's got into you?
You're really fired up, what's up?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if it isn't Trainey! I was just thinking
about whipping up a special seafood okonomiyaki.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Care to try some too if you'd like?
I guarantee it's got a special flavor.

Just how delicious could this okonomiyaki be?
Curious, I followed them to find—
It was the sea.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Here, it's Trainer's fishing rod.
I'm expecting you to land a big one!"
choice_data_list: Procuring it on-site, of all things!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Anywhere can be a kitchen as long as you've got cooking utensils!
Let's do our best to help Hishi Ama-san~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I heard you have a special preference~.
Since I'm here, I figured I'd mix it in for you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, okonomiyaki time~♪.
Let's catch a bunch and top it with everything~
After that, I went fishing with Hishi Amazon and the others to gather ingredients, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Mmm...! Just waiting around like this is tough work.
But hey, this is a one-on-one showdown with the fish!
Perhaps because I'm a beginner, I just couldn't seem to get any fish to bite...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Look, look~! Look at the seashell I found~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Nicely done, Mirako! ...Wait.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Aren't there seashells mixed in with this?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... It was so pretty, I just couldn't resist.
I thought it's important to take a breather once in a while, too~
I couldn't really find ingredients, so I ended up taking a detour.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Phew, I'm home~!
choice_data_list: Did you just go free diving!?
Did you just go free diving!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I want everyone's tummies to be full
and feel bono♪ ...Then again~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: All I could find was this tee~ny tiny shrimp~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Mumu, that didn't go so well, huh...
Still, great find bringing it here, Akebono!

Despite a grand and daring search for ingredients,
they weren't able to find results to match.
As a consequence—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Phew...! Now we can finally start cooking...
Good work, everyone...!
choice_data_list: You're completely worn out, aren't you...

text_block_list.text:
To think collecting enough for everyone would be this difficult.
Just as I was kicking myself for not suggesting buying them at a store sooner—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hehe, don't make that face—just watch me!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Lastly, we top the diamond-shaped okonomiyaki
with green laver and white mayonnaise...
and voilà, it's done!"

I took a bite of the okonomiyaki handed to me
by Hishi Amazon. And then—

The flavors of okonomiyaki and seafood soak into
my exhausted body! It's so delicious I can't stop eating...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you've got a great appetite!
...That's the flavor you arrive at after all that hard work.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Dishes made from ingredients lined up in front of the shop are delicious too. But, you know—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
There are things you can only gain
precisely because you seized them with your own hands.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Mmm...! It was tough to make,
but all that fatigue just melts right away~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Because we worked so hard!
It's a special Buono just for us♪"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It's not just about pursuing efficiency and results—
there are dishes you can only truly savor if you have dreams and obsession!
choice_data_list: I'd like to let the girls at the dorm have some too.
It's the same as a race, huh
It's the same as a race, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
It's not just about pursuing efficiency and results—
there are dishes you can only truly savor if you have dreams and obsession!
choice_data_list: I'd like to let the girls at the dorm have some too.
It's the same as a race, huh
It's the same as a race, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Then let's invite the dorm girls next time.
We could ask Fuji and make it a joint project between the Miho and Ritto dorms!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "It'll surely be a dreamy... unforgettable dish for everyone as well!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, well said!
Races aren't just about chasing victory, after all—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "Besides, there are some things you can only gain from a head-to-head showdown against a strong opponent!"
Something gained only because of their dreams and obsession—an irreplaceable dish that only the two of them could ever create.
